verdict.rationale: Statsig ships its own MCP server that lets AI clients such as Claude Code and Cursor 'explore experiments, and access your Statsig data'. It also has a Console API that does programmatically what the web console does, so an agent can read experiment configurations. The docs only imply, rather than state, that experiment results (metric lifts and confidence intervals) can be read through these interfaces, and nothing documents ship/rollback decision support. Missing for 10: explicit docs for reading experiment scorecard results via API or MCP, any documented ship/rollback decision workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agents summarizing results.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
reports metric lifts with confidence intervals
